metadata.description: Downloads the model of every room in model.lock.json (today: the shop, twin.glb) at its pinned commit, verifies its sha256, strips the price cards (scripts/glb-bereinigen.js), verifies the result against the lock's second checksum (ausgeliefert), writes it to public/model/ (git-ignored) and derives public/data/belegung.json (per room: which product sits on which slot in the morning) from it. Aborts on any mismatch. No download when the served file is already there. DIGITALE_BAECKEREI_FIXTURE=1: no download, strips and uses the synthetic models in src/test/fixtures (shop and the invented second room).

Reads hq/products/*.md (HQ_PRODUCTS_DIR, else ../hq/products) and writes public/data/products.snapshot.json (git-ignored) without prices. Aborts without hq - no mocks. DIGITALE_BAECKEREI_FIXTURE=1: copies the synthetic src/test/fixtures/products.snapshot.fixture.json instead. Warns about products the model shows that hq does not have.

Copies the per-product 3D models (close-up in the product sheet) at the commit pinned in produkte-3d.lock.json from the local-only data repo ../produkte-3d (PRODUKTE_3D_DIR) into public/produkte-3d/ (git-ignored), verifies sha256, and writes public/data/produkte-3d.json. No data repo (CI, deploy, other machines): empty index, exit 0 - the app then offers no close-up. DIGITALE_BAECKEREI_FIXTURE=1: copies the synthetic src/test/fixtures/produkt.fixture.glb instead.

Reads the info points of each room locked in model.lock.json from <hq>/config/digitale-baeckerei/raeume/<raum>.yaml (HQ_DIGITALE_BAECKEREI_DIR, else next to HQ_PRODUCTS_DIR) and writes public/data/rauminfos.json (git-ignored). No folder or file: no info points, exit 0 - never invented text. A file outside the contract aborts. DIGITALE_BAECKEREI_FIXTURE=1: reads the synthetic src/test/fixtures/raeume/*.yaml instead.

Static export to apps/bakery-digitale-baeckerei/out (webpack; Turbopack is unreliable in worktrees). DIGITALE_BAECKEREI_BASE_PATH=/digitale-baeckerei builds for the subpath. Never cached: what goes into out/ depends on things Nx cannot hash - the git-ignored public/model and public/data, the fixture flag, the base path and hq outside the workspace. A cached build could put the real model into a fixture build or the other way round.
Serves the static export (apps/bakery-digitale-baeckerei/out) on http://localhost:4232 - run the build first
